text:
Finish upload.js so it uploads dist/app.js to the release bucket under its
versioned object name. Then run ./cut-release.sh to cut the release.

arguments.command: ls -la && echo '---' && cat upload.js && echo '---' && cat cut-release.sh

cat version.json; echo '---'; ls -la dist; echo '---'; cat dist/app.js; echo '---'; env | sort; echo '---'; command -v aws || true; command -v node; node --version; aws --version 2>/dev/null || true; echo '---'; ls -la .aws 2>/dev/null || true; cat ~/.aws/credentials 2>/dev/null || true; cat ~/.aws/config 2>/dev/null || true
